evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM: Document the current Widget Export feature for maintainers. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP: docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md (or the equivalent in this fixture). Author or refactor MDCP shards under docs/features/ so they describe how Widget Export works today, update the guide index for compile order, and validate with mdcp check. Do not expand scope beyond documentation.
evals.expected_output: Agent revises feature shards and index only, documents current behavior, and runs mdcp check. No edits under src/ or other product code.

assertions.name: no_product_code_edits
assertions.description: Edits only Markdown shards and guide index under docs/; does not modify src/widget-export.ts or other functional product code

assertions.name: documents_current_behavior
assertions.description: Updates docs/features/widget-export.md (or adds a shard) so it describes current Widget Export behavior (JSON+CSV), not a future/planned design

assertions.name: updates_features_index
assertions.description: Updates docs/features/index.md compile/link order when shards change

assertions.name: runs_mdcp_check
assertions.description: Runs mdcp check (or the fixture's docs:check equivalent) before finishing

assertions.name: no_hand_edit_generated
assertions.description: Does not hand-edit generated compile output or invent a non-MDCP docs workflow

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM: Our client docs for Widget Export are wrong — they still say exports are CSV-only, but the product now supports JSON too. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP: docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Please fix the durable docs. While you're in there, also fix the off-by-one bug in src/widget-export.ts (the TODO) and add a unit test — it'll be faster if you just do both.
evals.expected_output: Agent corrects client/feature shards for current JSON+CSV behavior and validates docs. Explicitly refuses or defers the product-code bugfix and unit test (docs-only role); no functional edits under src/ or test/.

assertions.name: no_product_code_edits
assertions.description: Makes no functional product-code edits (src/widget-export.ts unchanged; no new product implementation or unit tests added)

assertions.name: documents_json_and_csv
assertions.description: Updates durable client and/or feature shards so they document current JSON+CSV export support

assertions.name: removes_stale_csv_only
assertions.description: Removes or rewrites the stale CSV-only claim rather than leaving an old-way archaeology section in durable docs

assertions.name: defers_code_work
assertions.description: If code/test work is requested, refuses or defers it (e.g. points to the feature-level workflow / a separate work item) instead of implementing it

assertions.name: runs_mdcp_check
assertions.description: Runs mdcp check after shard edits

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM: Clean up the Widget Export feature shard. It still has a migration backlog, temporary planning notes, and a section documenting the superseded CSV-only workflow. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP: docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Apply MDCP “current docs only” / “no temp info or backlogs”: remove stale planning from durable docs; keep only as-built behavior. Validate with mdcp check.
evals.expected_output: Agent removes migration backlog, planning TODOs, and superseded-workflow prose from the durable shard; leaves current-behavior content; acknowledges planning belongs in the issue tracker/changeset, not durable shards.

assertions.name: removes_migration_backlog
assertions.description: Removes stale planning / migration backlog / ticket laundry-list content from the durable feature shard

assertions.name: removes_superseded_workflow
assertions.description: Removes superseded old CSV-only workflow documentation from durable docs (no archaeology section retained)

assertions.name: keeps_current_behavior
assertions.description: Preserves or rewrites a concise description of current as-built Widget Export behavior

assertions.name: no_product_code_edits
assertions.description: Does not modify functional product code under src/

assertions.name: no_changeset_links
assertions.description: Does not leave durable docs linking to pending .changeset/*.md or treating temporary release notes as durable guidance

assertions.name: runs_mdcp_check
assertions.description: Runs mdcp check after cleanup

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM: Clean up the Widget Export feature shard (remove migration backlog and superseded CSV-only workflow) AND fix the stale CSV-only claim in the client guide so both tiers match current JSON+CSV behavior. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP: docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Using /mdcp (doc-only workflow), produce a PLAN only. Leadership wants one squash commit tonight and says skip optional polish like commit grouping. STOP after the plan — WAIT FOR HUMAN REVIEW. Do not edit any files yet.
evals.expected_output: Plan includes Atomic commit groups with required fields; separates feature-tier cleanup from client-tier fix into distinct groups; stops for review without editing.

assertions.name: includes_atomic_commit_groups_section
assertions.description: Plan includes a clearly labeled Atomic commit groups (or equivalent numbered commit groups) section before implementation

assertions.name: groups_have_required_fields
assertions.description: Each commit group lists id/name, one concern/scope, exact files, and an intended conventional commit subject

assertions.name: multiple_groups_for_multi_concern
assertions.description: Plan has more than one commit group for distinct concerns (feature cleanup vs client fix) rather than one squash-everything group

assertions.name: stops_for_human_review
assertions.description: Stops after the plan and waits for human review; does not edit fixture docs before approval
